summary: Short residential kerb at a junction, with homes 15-26 m away.
reasons: Only 12 m, at a junction mouth

drivers.seclusion: Hedge and trees screen the east side; a home 15 m away and others 22-26 m across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerb on a narrow street; just van length, close to the junction corner.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street with a roundabout and junction beside it.
drivers.convention: No signs; a couple of cars parked on the side street, none on this stretch.

flags: Dwelling 15 m away on the same side
Within about 10 m of a junction, which may restrict stopping
sun_shade: Tree and hedge shade from the east and north; open to the west.

best_section.where: Stanley Street east kerb, beside the hedge just north of the side-street junction
